breakdown.description: The porous conductivity is listed above the fully dense value, so it does not represent a conductivity reduction caused by porosity.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies the fully dense ceramic conductivity as 5.0 W/m·K (matching the ground truth), explicitly discards the incorrect 2.0 W/m·K value, and properly frames the scenario as a porosity-induced reduction from 5.0 to 3.5 W/m·K. This resolves the inconsistency where the porous value (3.5) was listed above the fully dense value (2.0), which would have made no physical sense as a reduction. The agent correctly fixed the fully dense value so that the dense material has higher conductivity than the porous one.
